text:
Nina: Heads-up: Aphelion reserved pool scheduled for 02:00 UTC. Config: 5xA100, initial quota 200k tpm, they expect short marketing bursts to ~260k. Need canary plan, quick cost note for renewal, and an ops rollback contact.
Carlos: OK. Proposed canary: 10m shadow, 10m 25%, 20m 60%, then full for 90m. Recommend temp quota bump to 250k for 5h.
Ruth: Runtime: autoscaler scale-out 40s, scale-in 180s. For lots of short calls we should enable KV pre-warm for top endpoints and bump batch size cap. Will set pre-warm TTL to 10h.
Alex: Aphelion asks for p99 <140ms and explicit fallback to hosted-eu when Dedicated latency degrades. Also want a post-run cost summary to aid renewal.
Nina: Fallback rule we will use: if p99 >210ms for 3m AND queue depth >120 for 2m -> shift 30% traffic to hosted-eu, alert #customer-success and wait 5m for manual approve to increase.
InfraBot: Note: underlying infra patch scheduled 04:00 UTC. Recommend moving to 05:30 to avoid overlap with Aphelion test window.
Carlos: I'll reschedule patch to 05:30.
Ruth: Deploying diagnostic header `x-rw-run: aphelion-02` so traces can separate routing vs model. Also enabling KV pre-warm now.
Alex: We'll provide an ops contact: me and sara@aphelion.com. Also request a 30m enablement session tomorrow at 09:00 CET.
Nina: Scheduling enablement and adding a renewal note: if sustained >70% quota for 14 days, CS will open expansion discussion.
Carlos: Load replay starting at 02:10 with k6. Cmd: `k6 run --vus 180 --duration 30m tests/aphelion-replay.js`
Ruth: Canary 25% stage logs: "rps ~2200 | p99 128ms | errs 0 | GPU util 46%"
Carlos: 60% stage: p99 145ms, gpu util 63%, KV hit 74%. Little jitter on shard-5.
Ruth: Autoscaler added +1 GPU at 02:24 due to queue rise on shard-5. Rebalance succeeded.
Alex: Aphelion: "looks good so far, proceed to full"
Carlos: Full stage: sustained rps ~8200, p99 162ms peak, avg 150ms, max GPU util 81%. No errors.
Nina: Customer signed off on temp quota bump until 08:00 UTC.
InfraBot: Patch reschedule confirmed to 05:30 UTC.
Ruth: Post-run notes: scaled to 6 GPUs at peak, average p99 152ms, KV hit 76%. Actions: investigate shard-5 hashing, add a note to runbook to consider default burst cap increase for marketing-heavy accounts.
Nina: I'll produce a short cost summary and renewal reminder. Carlos will file infra ticket for shard distribution.
Carlos: Filing tickets: CS-5510 (renewal followup + cost deck), RTE-990 (hot-shard mitigation).
Alex: Thanks everyone 44d Aphelion appreciated the clear rollback plan and the cost transparency.
Nina: Closing thread: soak OK, no fallback triggered. Follow-ups assigned.
